mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points from the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE increases by more than 0.2pp month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in residential construction (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO increase month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: During active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high labor market slack (UNRATE > 4.5% and rising for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5% and rising for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer demand (RSAFS growth > 0.5% month-over-month and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to elevated corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS MoM growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.5% and the federal funds rate is above 4.5%, the combination signals a high-inflation, hawkish monetary policy environment that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
